Let's start by including all the Boston Harbor beach datasheets in a unified analysis. I want to see how rainfall over 1, 2, and 3 days correlates with Enterococcus levels across these beaches. This will help me understand the general trends and any potential patterns in water quality related to weather conditions. Could you provide a summary or visualization of this data?

SYSTEM OUTPUT:

Beach                             | 1-day  | 2-day  | 3-day

Constitution Beach                | 0.248  | 0.264  | 0.205
M Street Beach                    | 0.134  | 0.106  | 0.098
Pleasure Bay & Castle Island Beach| 0.056  | 0.036  | 0.025
Carson Beach                      | 0.097  | 0.116  | 0.109
City Point Beach                  | 0.008  | 0.002  | 0.001

Overall (all beaches combined):
• 1-day rainfall vs Enterococcus: ρ = 0.169
• 2-day rainfall vs Enterococcus: ρ = 0.172
• 3-day rainfall vs Enterococcus: ρ = 0.135

Interpretation:
- Constitution Beach shows the strongest linkage (especially 2-day totals).  
- City Point Beach shows almost no correlation.  
- Across all sites, 2-day rainfall correlates slightly more with Enterococcus than 1- or 3-day totals.

Would you like me to generate visual charts (e.g., bar plots of these correlations or scatter plots of rain vs. Enterococcus) to illustrate these patterns?```
